messages:
Maria (Sales): Starting thread for MapleBank POC — buyer needs enterprise SSO (SAML), SCIM group provisioning (bulk onboarding ~600 users), RBAC mapping from Okta groups to app roles, and tenant domain locking. They asked for a 3-month pilot; need hosted vs dedicated cost comparison and a list of technical/legal blockers.

Samir (Eng): Quick clarifying q: is the SCIM onboarding a single bulk wave or phased syncs? Also what's the expected peak concurrent sessions during POC?

Maria (Sales): Single bulk wave of ~600 in week 1, then ~100/month incremental. Peak concurrency ~60 users.

Derek (Solutions): For those numbers Hosted will work fine for the short POC unless they require private networking/VPC. Dedicated if they insist on isolated GPUs, BYOK, or SLA-backed latency. Main blockers: domain verification if they want tenant-locked, SCIM rate limits during bulk onboard, SAML attribute mapping for role assignment, and KMS/HSM for keys if they demand BYOK.

Olivia (Security): We need the completed vendor security questionnaire + their data flow diagram. Confirm if they require BYOK/HSM or just customer-managed keys in KMS. Also ask whether SCIM account creds are ephemeral or long-lived — influences our token rotation guidance.

deploy-bot: Docs: https://docs.redwood.com/auth/enterprise-sso-scim — includes SAML metadata example, SCIM bulk payloads, domain proofing steps, and RBAC mapping patterns.

Samir (Eng): SCIM notes for ops: we support bulk (single POST with array) and incremental delta. Default rate limit = 600 req/min; we can temporarily bump for onboarding with ops approval. Recommended batch size: 200. Sample config snippet to share with customer:
```
SAML:
  entity_id: https://org.okta.com/app/xxxx
  acs: https://redwood.example.com/sso/acs
  attributes:
    email: urn:okta:attribute:email
    groups: urn:okta:attribute:groups
SCIM:
  token: scim-svc-xxxx
  bulk: true
  recommended_batch: 200
```
For RBAC: Okta group -> Redwood role mapping can be configured via our admin UI or provisioned via SCIM group_to_role custom attribute.

Maria (Sales): Pricing: buyer asked for rough Hosted vs Dedicated numbers for 3 months to include in SOW. Can we get ballpark by EOD?

Derek (Solutions): Ballpark (for expected usage ~8–12M tokens/mo and moderate embedding calls):
- Hosted (pay-as-you-go): ~$5k/mo — no infra commitment, simple onboarding.
- Dedicated (small reserved pool): ~$16k/mo + one-time network/setup fee (~$3k) — includes isolated capacity and SLA.
Include POC discount if they choose Dedicated after pilot. Will draft formal quote.

Olivia (Security): Additional legal/security asks to flag to customer: SOC2 status, data residency for logs, whether logs must remain in their VPC during POC, cert rotation cadence for SAML metadata, and incident response contacts. I'll prepare a minimal answers packet to speed their legal review.

Samir (Eng): Tech deliverables we need from the customer to start provisioning:
- IdP SAML metadata (cert + ACS + entity ID)
- SCIM service account with write permissions + sample CSV for first-wave users
- Okta group->role mapping table (spreadsheet or JSON)
- DNS TXT or HTTP endpoint for domain proofing (they prefer tenant lock)
- Expected token volume and sample prompts for perf tuning
Once we have those I'll spin up a temporary SCIM sandbox and test SAML flow.

Maria (Sales): I'll email them for metadata and attach the security questionnaire. Derek, Samir, Olivia — please confirm owners: Derek will draft pricing/quote, Samir will stand up sandbox and handle SCIM, Olivia will shepherd security Qs.

Derek (Solutions): Confirmed — I'll send draft quote by 6pm PT.

Samir (Eng): Confirmed — will provision sandbox on receipt of creds. Ping me in thread or DM with the SCIM token.

Olivia (Security): Confirmed — I'll prep the initial security packet and a short checklist for their legal team.

Maria (Sales): Great — I'll collect the items and loop them in. Follow-ups: I'll post the customer's answers and SAML metadata here when I have them. :white_check_mark:
